subject: Scoped SOC 2 artifacts request — MFA rotation ledger, session slices, delegated access
messages:
From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@wellcare.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts for audit

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Our audit team is cataloging controls for our annual supplier review and has asked for your SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) plus a few scoped artifacts that go beyond the report. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by 2026-08-31?

- SOC 2 Type II (full report) and a short bridge letter if the report period doesn't align with our audit window.
- MFA rotation ledger for service accounts and console users that shows rotation events and the store associated (we only need metadata, not secrets).
- Sample session logs (redacted) for your primary production cluster "redwood-api-prod" covering at least one week between 2026-06-01 and 2026-07-31 — we want auth success/failure, token issuance times, and session duration.
- Evidence of periodic privileged access reviews and deprovisioning actions (export of the access review that touches the console/admin group).

If there are any limits on what you can share (PII, full raw logs), please call out alternatives (slices, redacted CSVs, summarized ledgers). Also tell us whether you can produce a bridge letter to cover any gap between your report period and our audit window.

Thanks — appreciate a short reply with what you can provide and a proposed delivery schedule.

Janelle
Security Program Manager
WellCare Health
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Janelle Park <janelle.park@wellcare.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts for audit

Hi Janelle — thanks for the clear list. We can support this scope; high-level plan below:

- SOC 2 Type II: will share the 2025-06-30 report (attached) and provide a bridge letter if needed.
- MFA rotation ledger: we can extract rotation event metadata (user/service account, rotation timestamp, rotation type). We will deliver as a CSV slice with hashes in place of actual secret identifiers.
- Session logs (sample): we can provide redacted session log slices for redwood-api-prod. To respect customer privacy we will redact IPs and any end-user PII; logs will include timestamps, auth result, token issued flag, session duration, and service/component tags.
- Access review evidence: export of the console/admin group review for the last completed quarterly cycle, including reviewer, decision, and any deprovisioning actions (redacted where necessary).

Questions:
1) Please confirm the exact time range you need for session logs (you mentioned June 1–July 31; is a contiguous 7-day slice inside that window fine?)
2) For the MFA rotation ledger, do you need HSM/KMS key rotation events, or only application/service credential rotations?

Target delivery: bridge letter + SOC 2 report by 2026-08-26; scoped CSV/log slices by 2026-08-30, pending security redaction review. If that timing works we'll proceed. I've looped in Ben (sales) to coordinate any legal/NDAs and Kim (security) for redaction and extraction.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Janelle Park <janelle.park@wellcare.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + supplemental artifacts for audit

Hi Neha — thanks, that plan looks good. A few clarifications:

- Session logs: a contiguous 7-day slice is fine. Please pick a representative week between 2026-06-01 and 2026-07-31 where you see typical traffic (avoid known incident windows).
- MFA rotation ledger: application/service credential rotations are sufficient; KMS/HSM key rotation events are optional. Include a column for the rotation trigger (automated/manual) if possible.
- Access review export: include the CSV/attachment and any internal runbook reference that shows the cadence (quarterly) and approver role.

Deadline: 2026-08-31 at EOD PT. For delivery, a Drive folder link + a short bridge letter PDF is preferred. If you can flag any items that will require a mutual NDA or additional redaction, call that out.

Thanks again — Janelle
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Kim — can your team produce:
- auth_rotation_ledgers_2026_Q2_Q3.csv (columns: subject_id, account_type, rotation_timestamp, rotation_type, trigger, artifact_hash)
- session_log_sample for redwood-api-prod (7-day contiguous slice inside June–July) with IPs and PII redacted, include fields: timestamp, auth_result, token_issue_time, session_duration_ms, service_tag
- access_review_export.csv for console/admin group last review (reviewer, reviewed_on, decision, action_taken)

Rishi — please prep a bridge-letter draft (I started one in Drive) and confirm whether we need any additional attestations for the export. Ben, please confirm whether WeCare has an NDA in place for raw slices; if not, legal may request a targeted NDA.

Subject: Re: Scoped SOC 2 artifacts request — delivery plan and sample attachments

Hi Janelle — quick update and delivery plan. Attached are the SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge-letter draft. The scoped artifacts are being uploaded to a shared Drive folder; below is what you'll see:

- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2025-06-30.pdf (attached)
- bridge-letter-draft-Redwood-WellCare.pdf (attached)
- auth_rotation_ledgers_2026_Q2_Q3.csv (CSV; rotation metadata only; no secrets)
- session_log_sample_redwood-api-prod-2026-06-15.csv (7-day contiguous slice centered on 2026-06-15; IPs and user identifiers redacted)
- access_review_export_console_admin_2026Q2.csv (access review export with reviewer decisions and documented deprovisioning actions)

Notes on redaction and scope:
- IP addresses redacted to /24; user identifiers replaced with stable pseudonyms (uid_hash) so you can validate counts without seeing PII.
- Rotation ledger includes a "trigger" column (automated/manual) and an artifact_hash so you can correlate events without exposing credentials.
- We did not include KMS/HSM key rotation events in the ledger — we can provide them under an NDA if required.

Delivery links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-soc2-evidence (will be shared with your security distribution)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/REDWOOD-2345 (internal tracking)

If you'd like a short call tomorrow to walk through the slices and redaction approach, I'm available 9–11am PT. Otherwise, confirm receipt and whether the redactions are acceptable for your audit.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
